felipebasurto-unslop-ui-unslop-ui.description: Strip AI-generated UI copy, decorative chrome (eyebrows, 01/02/03 numbering, badges, dots, arrows, edge stripes) and chart clutter (titles, legends, gridlines) from web pages, apps, dashboards and charts. Use when asked to clean up, tighten, polish, declutter, unslop or humanize interface copy and visual surface (gradients, spacing, motion, edge alignment), cut filler or em dashes, when a screen looks AI-made or generic, or as a final pass once you finish building or restyling a screen. Not for the build itself: layout redesigns, new features, chart-type or data changes, logic refactors, or…
